The '''Ruur Killik Burrows''' was a cave network in the mountains of [[King's Pass]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] that was inhabited by the [[Ruur]] [[Killik/Legends|Killik]] hive. The [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaanian]] noble [[House Syrush]]'s [[House Syrush (estate)|estate]] was built near the burrows, and when the Killik hive became active, they burst out of a tunnel in the cliff wall of the estate and overran it.
